title: Maximize Sum of Weights after Edge Removals
summary: Given a tree with n nodes and edge weights, remove edges so that each node connects to at most k other nodes and the sum of the remaining edge weights is maximized.
statement: Given a tree with n nodes and edge weights, remove edges so that each node connects to at most k other nodes and the sum of the remaining edge weights is maximized. Return the maximum sum of weights.
constraints: edges describes a connected n-node tree with positive weights; 1 <= k < n.
Remove any edges so every remaining node has degree at most k.
Return the maximum total weight of retained edges.
hints: A node has k child slots unless its parent edge is retained, when only k-1 remain.
Compute each child edge’s gain over dropping it and take the largest positive gains that fit.
Postorder the tree; return values for parent edge absent and present.
Subtrees interact only through the node degree, so sorting independent marginal gains makes the local choice optimal.
